Linux fixes ready; Mac unchanged.

  • Removed unnecessary NumPy reductions and broadcast views from lattice recording.

Linux diagnostics improved phase N4096 to 1.65× upstream, cylindrical wave N128 to 1.49×, regular translation N128 to 1.11×. These are provisional; final Mac/Linux campaign reruns remain required. No commits or pushes.
